an6.16:1.1: Ekam samayaṃ Bhagavā Bhaggesu viharati Suṃsumāragire Bhesakaḷāvane Migadāye.
an6.16:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Nakulapitā gahapati ābādhiko hoti dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
an6.16:1.3: Atha kho Nakulamātā gahapatānī Nakulapitaraṃ gahapatiṃ etad avoca:-- 2.
an6.16:2.1: Mā kho tvaṃ gahapati sāpekho kālam akāsi.
an6.16:2.4: Siyā kho pana te gahapati evam assa
an6.16:2.5: ‘Nakulamātā gahapatānī mam' accayena na sakkoti dārake posetuṃ gharāvāsaṃ santharitun' ti.
an6.16:2.6: Na kho pan'etaṃ gahapati evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
an6.16:2.7: Kusalā 'haṃ gahapati kappāsaṃ kantituṃ veṇiṃ olikhituṃ,
an6.16:2.8: sakkom' ahaṃ gahapati tav' accayena dārake posetuṃ gharāvāsaṃ santharituṃ.
an6.16:2.9: Tasmā ti ha tvaṃ gahapati mā sāpekho kālam akāsi.
an6.16:3.1: Siyā kho pana te gahapati evam assa
an6.16:3.2: ‘Nakulamātā gahapatānī mam' accayena aññaṃ gharaṃ gamissatī' ti.
an6.16:3.3: Na kho pan'etaṃ gahapati evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
an6.16:3.4: Tvañ c'eva kho gahapati jānāsi, ahañ ca, yathā no soḷasavassāni gahaṭṭhakaṃ brahmacariyaṃ samāciṇṇaṃ.
an6.16:3.5: Tasmā ti ha tvaṃ gahapati mā sāpekho kālam akāsi.
an6.16:4.1: Siyā kho pana te gahapati evam assa
an6.16:4.2: ‘Nakulamātā gahapatānī mam' accayena na dassanakāmā bhavissati Bhagavato, na dassanakāmā bhikkhusaṅghassā' ti.
an6.16:4.3: Na kho pan'etaṃ gahapati evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
an6.16:4.4: Ahaṃ hi gahapati tav' accayena dassanakāmatarā c'eva bhavissāmi Bhagavato dassanakāmatarā ca bhikkhusaṅghassa.
an6.16:4.5: Tasmā ti ha tvaṃ gahapati mā sāpekho kālam akāsi.
an6.16:5.1: Siyā kho pana te gahapati evam assa
an6.16:5.2: ‘Nakulamātā gahapatānī mam' accayena na sīlesu paripūrakārinī' ti.
an6.16:5.3: Na kho pan'etaṃ gahapati evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
an6.16:5.4: Yāvatā kho gahapati tassa Bhagavato sāvikā gihī odātavasanā sīlesu paripūrakāriniyo, ahan tāsaṃ aññatarā.
an6.16:5.5: Yassa kho pan'assa kaṅkhā vā vimati vā, ayaṃ so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho Bhaggesu viharati Suṃsumāragire Bhesakaḷāvane Migadāye, taṃ Bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamitvā pucchatu.
an6.16:5.6: Tasmā ti ha tvaṃ gahapati mā sāpekho kālam akāsi.
an6.16:6.1: Siyā kho pana te gahapati evam assa
an6.16:6.2: ‘Nakulamātā gahapatānī na lābhinī ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassā' ti.
an6.16:6.3: Na kho pan'etaṃ gahapati evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
an6.16:6.4: Yāvatā kho gahapati tassa Bhagavato sāvikā gihī odātavasanā lābhiniyo ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa, ahan tāsaṃ aññatarā.
an6.16:6.5: Yassa kho pan'assa kaṅkhā vā vimati vā, ayaṃ so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho Bhaggesu viharati Suṃsumāragire Bhesakaḷāvane Migadāye, taṃ Bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamitvā pucchatu.
an6.16:6.6: Tasmā ti ha tvaṃ gahapati mā sāpekho kālam akāsi.
an6.16:7.1: Siyā kho pana te gahapati evam assa
an6.16:7.2: ‘Nakulamātā gahapatānī na imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ogādhappattā paṭigādhappattā assāsappattā tiṇṇavicikicchā vigatakathaṃkathā vesārajjappattā aparappaccayā Satthu sāsane viharatī' ti.
an6.16:7.3: Na kho pan'etaṃ gahapati evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
an6.16:7.4: Yāvatā kho gahapati tassa Bhagavato sāvikā gihī odātavasanā imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ogādhappattā paṭigādhappattā assāsappattā tiṇṇavicikicchā vigatakathaṃkathā vesārajjappattā aparappaccayā Satthu sāsane viharantiyo, ahan tāsaṃ aññatarā.
an6.16:7.5: Yassa kho pan'assa kaṅkhā vā vimati vā, ayaṃ so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho Bhaggesu viharati Suṃsumāragire Bhesakaḷāvane Migadāye, taṃ Bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamitvā pucchatu.
an6.16:7.6: Tasmā ti ha tvaṃ gahapati mā sāpekho kālam akāsi.
an6.16:7.8: garahitā ca Bhagavatā sāpekhassa kālakiriyā ti. 3.
an6.16:8.1: Atha kho Nakulapituno gahapatissa Nakulamātarā gahapatāniyā iminā ovādena ovadiyamānassa so ābādho ṭhānaso paṭippassambhi,
an6.16:8.2: vuṭṭhahi ca Nakulapitā gahapati tamhā ābādhā.
an6.16:8.3: Tathā pahīno ca pana Nakulapituno gahapatissa so ābādho ahosi.
an6.16:8.4: Atha kho Nakulapitā gahapati gilānā vuṭṭhito aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā daṇḍam olubbha yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Nakulapitaraṃ gahapatiṃ Bhagavā etad avoca:-- 4.
an6.16:9.1: Lābhā te gahapati suladdhan te gahapati,
an6.16:9.2: yassa te Nakulamātā gahapatānī anukampikā atthakāmā ovādikā anusāsikā;
an6.16:9.3: yāvatā kho gahapati mama sāvikā gihī odātavasanā sīlesu paripūrakāriniyo, Nakulamātā gahapatānī tāsaṃ aññatarā;
an6.16:9.4: yāvatā kho gahapati mama sāvikā gihī odātavasanā labhiniyo ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa, Nakulamātā gahapatānī tāsaṃ aññatarā;
an6.16:9.5: yāvatā kho gahapati mama sāvikā gihī odātavasanā imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ogādhappattā paṭigādhappattā assāsappattā tiṇṇavicikicchā vigatakathaṃkathā vesārajjappattā aparappaccayā Satthu sāsane viharantiyo, Nakulamātā gahapatānī tāsaṃ aññatarā.
an6.16:9.6: Lābhā te gahapati suladdhan te gahapati,
an6.16:9.7: yassa te Nakulamātā gahapatānī anukampikā atthakāmā ovādikā anusāsikā
